legal_form: קרן סגורה, קרן סל (Israeli ETF under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994; traded on TASE, created and redeemed through the manager, ETF-04); קרן מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; exposure profile 40. Trustee: מזרחי טפחות חברה לנאמנות בע"מ. Tracking asset on Maya's fund page: ת"א-35 100%. Payment policy on Maya: 'לא מתחייבת לחלק תשלומים'. REPLICATION: physical: the assets that make up the tracking asset, plus synthetic contracts (options) on it (annual report p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'מנהל הקרן מייצר חשיפה לנכס המעקב באמצעות נכסים המרכיבים את נכס המעקב וכן באמצעות חוזים סינתטיים (אופציות) על נכס המעקב'). Size used to rank the fund (not a fee input): market value 3,137,081 thousand NIS on 23/10/2026 (TASE security page, 'שווי שוק').

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee as printed in the report: 0.25% of average annual net assets. Maya's fund page (https://maya.tase.co.il/he/funds/mutual-funds/1143700, read 2026-10-25) shows the same 'דמי ניהול' 0.25%. The manager committed to the ISA outline to raise its fees only on 1 January (ETF-16). Main prospectus published on Magna on 2026-07-01, reference 2026-03-062032 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts), as the report states; the prospectus block cites this report.

variable_management.notes: Variable management fee rate as printed: 0.1% a year of net assets. Maya's fund page shows 0.1%. The mechanism works in both directions (ETF-14): the amount actually charged or paid depends on the gap to the tracking asset.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The report's table 'תשואות, סטיות תקן ונתוני השוואה' (p. 5) prints the fund's return against its tracking asset: 2025 51.22% against 51.63%; 01.01.2026-30.06.2026 11.84% against 11.99%. Its comparison with the tracking asset of the previous report (p. 5) prints for 01.07.2025-30.06.2026 the fund's shekel return 37.08% against the tracking asset's change 37.45%. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). The ISA directive (ETF-07(e)) makes the manager publish the 12-month tracking difference every pricing day; this report points to the third-party page https://fundscenter.co.il/funds.shtml?m=3 for it. That page (Funds Center by Guideline, run for the managers) states on the page 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here (same position as CAT-43 for TASE lists); founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: No median bid-ask spread is printed in the annual report; the report prints only the range and average of the differences between unit value and exchange price, a premium/discount measure, not a spread (ETF-06). The median spread is published under ETF-07(b) on the same third-party page (https://fundscenter.co.il/funds.shtml?m=3), whose terms forbid redistribution; not copied. Creation and redemption fee on direct orders to the manager: 0.10% each (p. 1; ETF-05).
